transitions.observation: In review/page-02.png, 02-4 is an evening office with sunset light. 03-1 is a bright reception with a QR stand, waiting chairs and the desk monitor. The caption 'A later morning:' states the time jump, and the shift in light and setting confirms it, so the change of day and room is not abrupt.

The scene moves from the reception counter to a sunny street. The teal awning and glass doors with the reception visible behind Priya place her outside the same clinic. The caption 'Some check in ahead...' frames the panel as a second route rather than a sequel to 03-1.

03-3 is just inside the glass entrance. The 03-3 background in the preview shows Meera at the desk and a seated elderly man and a woman in a pink kurti, so Raman and Priya have already arrived. The caption names Ravi, the new protagonist, at first appearance.

This is a direct action cut. The phone held to the QR stand in 03-3 becomes an over-the-shoulder close-up of the same phone and green sleeve, now showing a form with a tick-box. 'his own phone' clearly refers back to Ravi.

The form is submitted and the scene moves to the waiting area. Raman, Priya and Ravi sit left to right in the same order as A-10 · A-11 · A-12 on the TV. Ravi has his phone in hand and his bag on his lap, which carries over from 03-3 and 03-4.

In review/page-04.png, 04-1 shows the same chairs, now with Raman and Priya gone, and Ravi standing with the bag back on his shoulder. The TV label reads 'NOW · A-12', which confirms the Ravi = A-12 link suggested by the order in 03-5. The caption 'Soon, his slot comes up.' covers the short wait.

readingReview.comparison: The first reader's order matches the intended order exactly: 03-1 [1], 03-2 [1], 03-3 [1], 03-4 [1], 03-5 [1, 2]. Each concern was checked. (a) Raman and Priya are unnamed. That is acceptable: source PAGE 3 calls them only 'an elderly patient' and 'a young woman', the captions say 'patients' and 'Some', and the names exist only in the cast data. (b) Ravi = A-12 must be visible. That is resolved in the art: the left-to-right seating in 03-5 matches the slot order, and 04-1 shows 'NOW · A-12' as only Ravi stands with the two chairs beside him empty. (c) The page is all narration. That is acceptable: source PAGE 3 itself is caption-only, and the accepted art carries the acting (Meera's greeting smile, Priya tapping, Ravi scanning and ticking, the shared upward look). (d) 'his own phone' is unambiguous, as the first reader noted. Page 03 changed only through the 04-2 shoulder-bag record, and the SVG and PNG are unchanged in substance. Nothing is unresolved.
